question: “A bad patch” — Choose the correct meaning.
solution:
A period of difficulty or trouble.

याद रखो: खराब PATCH यानी जिंदगी का खराब phase.

PATCH = temporary phase. So a BAD PATCH = a bad/difficult phase.

Ravi described the situation as “A bad patch” during the morning meeting because it turned into a difficult situation after several mistakes.

question: “A blessing in disguise” — Choose the correct meaning.
solution:
Something that seems bad at first but turns out to be beneficial.

याद रखो: 'Bad outside, Blessing inside' = blessing in disguise.

DISGUISE = भेष/छुपा हुआ. Blessing छुपी हुई है, इसलिए शुरुआत में problem दिखेगी लेकिन फायदा निकलेगा.

At the office, Neha said that “A blessing in disguise” was the right expression because the situation was deliberately kept away from public attention.

question: “A bolt from the blue” — Choose the correct meaning.
solution:
A sudden and unexpected shock or event.

BLUE SKY → अचानक LIGHTNING → SUDDEN SHOCK.

BLUE sky से अचानक BOLT (बिजली) गिरने की कल्पना करो—बिना warning के sudden shock.

In the discussion, the school captain used “A bolt from the blue” to explain how the situation felt nervous before the important announcement.

question: “A bone of contention” — Choose the correct meaning.
solution:
A subject or cause of disagreement/dispute.

BONE पर CONTENTION (झगड़ा) = cause of dispute.

एक BONE को दो लोग खींच रहे हैं और लड़ रहे हैं—जिस चीज पर झगड़ा हो वही bone of contention.

The example of “A bone of contention” came up when the shopkeeper noticed that the situation caused disagreement between the two groups.

question: “A cakewalk” — Choose the correct meaning.
solution:
A very easy task or something requiring little effort.

CAKE + WALK = Easy Task.

CAKE तक आराम से WALK करना = कोई मेहनत नहीं → बहुत easy.

our coach gave “A cakewalk” as the best expression after noticing that the situation became easy after the teacher explained the method.

question: “A can of worms” — Choose the correct meaning.
solution:
A complicated problem or situation that creates many more problems when opened or discussed.

CAN खोलो → WORMS निकलें → Complicated issue.

एक CAN खोलते ही बहुत सारे WORMS बाहर निकलें—एक problem खोलो और कई नई problems सामने आ जाएँ.

the project manager described the situation as “A can of worms” while checking the records because it became a serious obstacle to the plan.

question: “A close-fisted person” — Choose the correct meaning.
solution:
A miser; a person who is unwilling to spend money.

CLOSED FIST = पैसा हाथ से बाहर नहीं → MISER.

FIST को कसकर CLOSE करके पैसे पकड़कर रखना = पैसा खर्च न करना → miser.

At the school gate, my elder brother said that “A close-fisted person” was the right expression because the situation played only a small part in the larger project.

question: “A cog in the machine” — Choose the correct meaning.
solution:
A small or insignificant part/role in a larger system.

COG = छोटा gear → बड़े MACHINE का छोटा role.

Machine का छोटा COG अकेले machine नहीं चलाता, लेकिन system का छोटा जरूरी part होता है.

In the discussion, the new student used “A cog in the machine” to explain how the situation was considered unreliable because of repeated excuses.

question: “A cold fish” — Choose the correct meaning.
solution:
An unfriendly or emotionally unresponsive person.

COLD person → NO WARMTH/EMOTION → Unfriendly person.

Cold = भावनाएँ ठंडी, Fish = expressionless/quiet image. यानी ऐसा व्यक्ति जो warmth या emotion नहीं दिखाता.

The example of “A cold fish” came up when the village head noticed that the situation was laughed at after making the embarrassing mistake.

question: “A dark horse” — Choose the correct meaning.
solution:
An unexpected winner or a person whose abilities are not widely known beforehand.

DARK = hidden/unknown + HORSE = competitor → Unexpected winner.

Race में एक ऐसा HORSE सोचो जिसके जीतने की किसी ने उम्मीद नहीं की थी—अचानक वही winner.
